entities.name: Torit Mutiny and Anyanya Rebellion
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Torit Mutiny and Anyanya Rebellion, a transformative movement in South Sudan (1955–1969). Emerged from Juba Conference 1947. Catalyzed Addis Ababa Agreement 1972 and Sudan Autonomous Region.
